doc: OCP Microscaling MXFP8: E4M3 elements with one E8M0 power-of-two scale per 32-element block along the last axis; the E8M0 exponent byte rides a u8 carrier. Execution floors are capability records, never spec fields (native SM100; software-scaled sm89-class; decoded-float below). Scale byte b means 2^(b-127); v1 carries this convention in exactly one decode line (hf_fp8_blockwise.py:275) and NO producer, so these vectors come from an independent implementation written to the OCP spec, not from a shipped MX producer -- a weaker provenance than the fp8/nvfp4 sets and marked as such.
